dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, gradual 2D narrowing of the body width from the mid-anterior section toward the posterior endpoint.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Sparse, low-contrast greyish linear striations distributed across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; lack of sharp edges between pigmented striations and white baseline skin.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple high-frequency linear scars (rake marks) visible as greyish or white-contrast lines across the dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant presence of superficial linear rake marks across the dorsal and lateral-dorsal surface.
